D: A Hawaii vet falls for a woman with no short-term memory and has to win her over again every day.
P: Serve the mains when Lucy builds her waffle house at the Hukilau Café.
S: Crisp buttermilk waffles cut into squares and stacked
Mini waffles cooked in a waffle iron, stacked into small houses with a dab of butter and drizzled with maple syrup.
Cubed tuna in soy and sesame over sushi rice in small cups
Sushi-grade tuna cubed and tossed with soy, sesame oil and spring onion, served in small cups over rice.
Marine park chilli lime grilled pineapple
Henry's job at the marine park with Jocko the walrus

Pineapple spears grilled until caramelised and charred, finished with lime juice and a little chilli salt. Peel and core 1 ripe pineapple and cut into 12 long spears. Mix 2 tbsp brown sugar with the zest of 1 lime. Brush the spears with a little melted butter and sprinkle with the lime sugar. Grill on a hot barbecue or grill pan for 2 to 3 minutes a side until caramelised and charred. Squeeze over lime juice and sprinkle with a mix of 1 tsp salt and half a teaspoon chilli powder. Serve warm.
M: Seared beef patties with onion gravy
Beef patties seared on rice, topped with a fried egg and smothered in a brown onion gravy cooked down with stock for 15 minutes.

Chicken thighs marinated in pineapple juice, soy, ginger and brown sugar, grilled until sticky, with rice and slaw. Mix 125ml pineapple juice, 80ml soy, 60g brown sugar, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 2 crushed garlic cloves. Marinate 1kg chicken thigh in half of it for 4 hours. Simmer the rest for 5 minutes until syrupy. Grill the chicken over medium-high heat for 5 to 6 minutes a side, basting with the glaze, until sticky and charred. Serve with 1.5 cups steamed rice and a slaw of cabbage, carrot and lime.
W: Firm set coconut milk pudding cut into squares
Coconut milk, sugar and cornflour cooked until thick, set in a tray and cut into squares.
K: Fresh pineapple blended with ginger, lime and mint, strained

Fresh pineapple blended with ginger, lime and mint, strained and poured over ice, topped with soda water and a pineapple wedge. Blend 600g fresh pineapple chunks with 1 tbsp grated ginger, the juice of 1 lime, a few mint leaves and 250ml cold water until smooth. Strain through a sieve into a jug, pressing on the pulp. Fill 4 glasses with ice, divide the juice between them and top each with a splash of soda water. Finish with a pineapple wedge.

s.note: Crisp buttermilk waffles cut into squares and stacked

s.note: Cubed tuna in soy and sesame over sushi rice in small cups
s.how: Cube 300g sashimi tuna and toss with 2 tbsp soy sauce, a teaspoon of sesame oil and sliced spring onion. Spoon cooked sushi rice into small cups and top with the tuna. Serve chilled, the same way every day.

m.note: Seared beef patties with onion gravy
m.how: Shape 600g beef mince into 4 patties and sear until cooked. Soften a sliced onion in the pan, stir in a spoon of flour and 500ml beef stock and simmer 15 minutes. Serve the patties on jasmine rice, topped with a fried egg and the gravy.

w.note: Firm set coconut milk pudding cut into squares
w.how: Whisk 800ml coconut milk, 100g sugar and 6 tbsp cornflour over low heat until very thick. Pour into a lined tray and chill for 3 hours until firm. Cut into squares and scatter with toasted shredded coconut.

d.note: Fresh pineapple blended with ginger, lime and mint, strained
d.how: Blend 600g fresh pineapple chunks with 1 tbsp grated ginger, the juice of 1 lime, a few mint leaves and 250ml cold water until smooth. Strain through a sieve into a jug, pressing on the pulp. Fill 4 glasses with ice, divide the juice between them and top each with a splash of soda water. Finish with a pineapple wedge.
